title: GET /v1/census/{edition}: one month of the census, as counts (CC BY 4.0)

edition.description: The month the edition records, YYYY-MM.

status.description: A draft is served to the network's operators only; a published or withdrawn one to everyone.

note.description: Why a withdrawn edition was withdrawn, or anything a reader must know; null when there is nothing.

publish_note.description: For an edition published from a draft taken before its month ended: why it went out as it was.

url.description: The method in words, with the edition.

min_sample.description: A country, kind of business, platform, source or city is published only with at least this many checked.

city_read.description: A city is partial until this share of its list (places) is checked.

rules_hash.description: The score rules' content the capabilities were read under: 16 hex of the SHA-256 of the document.

rules_share.description: The share of the checked scored under those rules when the counts were taken.

door_registry.description: The version of the door registry the doors were read by.

places_sources.description: The city lists the cities were counted from.

revised.description: The day those rules were last published or amended: a version amended in place counts differently.

score_rules.description: The score rules the capabilities' states were read under.

items.description: A name the vocabulary gives: lower case, never renamed. The list of this version is in the document.

capabilities.description: The capabilities counted, in vocabulary order.

items.description: A name the vocabulary gives: lower case, never renamed. The list of this version is in the document.
A name the vocabulary gives: lower case, never renamed. The list of this version is in the document.

levels.description: The readiness levels counted, lowest first.

propertyNames.description: all, country, group, platform, source or city; a reader skips a scope it does not know.

left_out.description: How many keys of each scope had fewer checked than min_sample, and are not in rows.

attribution.description: How to credit it: "Surfing Dog census, surfingdog.ai, CC BY 4.0".

credits.description: Credit for others' data the counts rest on, given with the attribution: "© Overture Maps Foundation" when the cities are counted from Overture Maps places data.

scope.description: all, country, group, platform, source or city; a reader skips a scope it does not know.

key.description: The scope's key: empty for all.

metric.description: checked, agent_ready, can:<capability>, door:<door type>, level:<level name>, no_ai, or for a city places.
